caption:
Toto had a summer off, then jumped straight into three hard preseason sessions a week. The hamstrings complained first.

Research suggests sharp increases in training load are linked with more soft tissue niggles. Build steadily: add a little distance or one extra session each week, and ease back slightly every third or fourth week.

Include short sprints early in preseason at lower volumes, plus strength work like bridges and Nordics, rather than saving speed for later. Add change-of-direction drills slowly too.

Our Chatswood physios can look at your training week and help plan a steady build to round one. Book online via the link in bio 🏉
